name: review
description: The review role on contract v3: per-requirement verdicts (Present|Surface|Absent|Incorrect|Unverifiable) on whether what was built matches what was specified — from the artifact and spec, never the builder's intent, never a fix. Directive carries the four facets; gates enforce record required fields, verdict vocabulary, closed_checks sha discipline (code_under_review:), and the Subject: issue-<n> trailer.
